verdict.rationale: Calendly ships a built-in AI assistant, Callie. Users can add it to any email thread to coordinate scheduling on their behalf [27][19]. The pricing page also describes an AI assistant that helps with the work around meetings, alongside recaps and action items [58][28], so delegating tasks inside the product is clearly supported. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of what tasks Callie can take on and how users control or approve its actions, and any independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as marketed.
